NER.note: A single authority for personal data and unique numbers, and a future register of civil events, are announced as plans; no link between civil register and ID is stated.
Digitisation of issued birth certificates is announced as future work; nothing is piloted or rolled out.
No count or share of people enrolled is given; the 8 million is a target for first birth certificates.
Unique numbers are to be given by a future authority; none at birth is stated.
Nothing is stated about who operates, maintains or owns the system.
Interoperability with public and private systems is financed for a future system; no register uses an ID number.

facts.fact: Le Sahel reports that on 16 September 2024 Interior Minister Mohamed Toumba said a new national identification system with unique identification numbers will be built, with World Bank-financed WURI-Niger supporting a single authority to manage all personal data and numbers.

systems.country_label: Projet d'identification unique en Afrique de l'Ouest pour l'intégration et l'inclusion régionale

NER.note: No land register is mentioned; property transactions are named only as a use of identification.
Only a file of terror suspects by ordinance and passport and ID card modernisation are mentioned; no station record system.
A national register of civil events is announced as future work under a 2019 law; no population register is stated as built or new.
Nothing is stated about local civil registration offices entering events digitally.
